title: Your First Weekend at St Catherine University, Shared as Cards
description: A low-pressure first-weekend loop through campus resources, gathering places, and recurring arts or activity options.

cards.title: Start at the Information Center
cards.subtitle: Friday arrival · Coeur de Catherine, second floor
cards.notes: Pick up a campus map, confirm weekend locations, and ask about checkout items before setting out on your first campus loop.
cards.short_summary: A practical first stop for directions, campus information, and student checkout items.
cards.evidence_claim: The Information Center provides campus maps, directions, event locations, and checkout items; academic-year weekend hours are 9 a.m.–10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Located on Coeur de Catherine's second floor. The university lists academic-year Saturday and Sunday hours as 9 a.m.–10 p.m.; break hours vary.

cards.title: Take in Dew Drop Pond
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · campus outdoor stop
cards.notes: Walk over for a short reset outdoors, then use the pond as an easy landmark while you orient yourself around the campus hub.
cards.short_summary: A named campus pond suited to a brief outdoor pause between indoor stops.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Catherine University identifies Dew Drop Pond as an outdoor oasis on campus.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus feature; check conditions and campus access before visiting.

cards.title: Meet up at City Sisters Coffee
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Coeur de Catherine, second floor
cards.notes: Choose a drink or snack if you want one, and use the pond-facing seating as a simple place to compare weekend plans.
cards.short_summary: A campus coffee and grab-and-go stop overlooking Dew Drop Pond.
cards.evidence_claim: City Sisters Coffee is on Coeur de Catherine's second floor overlooking Dew Drop Pond and offers beverages, bakery items, and grab-and-go snacks.
cards.access_notes: Located on the second floor of Coeur de Catherine; consult dining services for current hours and menu.

cards.title: Find the library before you need it
cards.subtitle: Friday late afternoon · Coeur de Catherine
cards.notes: Locate a study spot, computers, and the service desk now so your first independent work session has an easy starting point.
cards.short_summary: A campus study and research destination with collaborative work and librarian support.
cards.evidence_claim: The library supports independent and collaborative study, librarian consultation, computers, and access to ACTC-library items for St. Kate's students and faculty.
cards.access_notes: Located in Coeur de Catherine. Check the library site for current service and building hours.

cards.title: Make dinner plans at The Pulse
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Coeur de Catherine, first floor
cards.notes: Use the first-floor counter as a straightforward dinner option, then stay nearby if your group wants to keep talking after eating.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor campus dining option serving pizzas, hoagies, and other familiar fare.
cards.evidence_claim: Wildcat Kitchen at The Pulse is on Coeur de Catherine's first floor, accepts meal swipes for lunch and dinner, and serves personal pizzas, hoagies, and other items.
cards.access_notes: Consult dining services for current hours, menu, and meal-swipe eligibility.

cards.title: Try a game-room hangout
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · connected to The Pulse
cards.notes: Bring your student ID and check out a game from the Information Center for an easy, alcohol-free group activity on campus.
cards.short_summary: A student gathering space with a connected game room and checkout-based supplies.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pulse is a student-programming and gathering venue; its connected game room has games and activities, with supplies checked out from the Information Center using a valid student ID.
cards.access_notes: Game-room supplies require a valid student ID for checkout from the Information Center.

cards.title: Pause at Our Lady of Victory Chapel
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · building #2 on the campus map
cards.notes: Step inside for quiet reflection and look for the stained-glass and tile details; visitors of all faiths are welcomed by the university.
cards.short_summary: A historic campus chapel for reflection, prayer, and Sunday Mass.
cards.evidence_claim: The university describes Our Lady of Victory Chapel as welcoming people of all faiths for sacred ritual, prayer, and reflection; Sunday Mass is at 10:30 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The Chapel page lists Monday–Friday opening when the university is open and Sunday Mass at 10:30 a.m.; confirm current access before visiting.

cards.title: See what is showing at the Murphy Gallery
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · campus gallery
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition page before you go, then build a gallery visit around any listed artist talk or public program.
cards.short_summary: A named campus art gallery with changing exhibitions and associated programs.
cards.evidence_claim: The Catherine G. Murphy Gallery hosts exhibitions and listed exhibition events, including artist talks and performances.
cards.source_title: The Paglees: Between Reason and Madness
cards.access_notes: Exhibitions and event dates change; review the gallery's current exhibition page before visiting.

cards.title: Browse a route into campus life
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Coeur de Catherine 253
cards.notes: Stop by to learn where clubs work and meet, then choose one current organization or future activity fair to follow up with.
cards.short_summary: A campus base for student organizations, meetings, workshops, and leadership groups.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Organization Center is available to student clubs for meetings, workshops, presentations, and organizational work, and houses student-leadership offices.
cards.access_notes: The university identifies the Student Organization Center as Coeur de Catherine 253; check with Student Center and Activities for access or meeting details.

cards.title: End with a calendar check at The O'Shaughnessy
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · performance venue on campus
cards.notes: Look over the venue calendar and choose a future performance or campus event that fits your schedule, budget, and interests.
cards.short_summary: A campus performance venue with an event calendar spanning concerts, theater, dance, and lectures.
cards.evidence_claim: The O'Shaughnessy publishes an upcoming-events calendar for performances and community or university events at St. Catherine University.
cards.source_title: Events | The O'Shaughnessy at St. Catherine University
cards.access_notes: Event times, availability, and ticket prices vary; use the venue calendar and ticket information for the specific event.
